title: Behold Before You Behave
reading:
"The essential Christian message is not behave, but behold."

It's easy to reduce faith to behavior — what we do, what we avoid, how we perform. But Jesus never started with behavior. He started with relationship.

Behold means to look, to focus, to take in fully. When you behold Jesus — His kindness, His holiness, His love — you are changed from the inside out. Transformation begins with vision.

Trying to behave without first beholding leads to frustration. It creates a cycle of effort without lasting change. But when love is the source, obedience becomes the response.

You don't become like Jesus by focusing on yourself — you become like Him by focusing on Him.

Adoration fuels transformation.
reflection: How might your life change if your focus shifted from doing better to seeing Him more clearly?
abide: Jesus, open my eyes to see You more clearly. Let my love for You grow as I behold who You are. Transform me from the inside out.
